stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Inventory must precede Assets." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Assets → Inventory → Sales → Costs → Payroll
- Assets → Inventory → Sales → Payroll → Costs
